faq.a: It depends on what you want. Mindsera is stronger on analysis, frameworks, live voice calls, integrations and platforms (Android, iPad, Apple Watch, web). Auserene is stronger if you want an evening conversation that writes the entry and a meditation made from your day. Auserene is iPhone only.

Mindsera has a free Curious plan with the journal, habit tracker, frameworks and export. AI features, including memory, voice journaling and Call Mode, need Genius, though free members can try most of them once or a few times.

As of November 19, 2026, Mindsera Genius costs $14.99 a month or $129 a year on its website. Its App Store listing also shows a $99 annual offer and a $17.99 monthly offer. Students, people over 65 and people with disabilities can ask for 40% off.

Yes, on Genius. Its Memory Profile is a set of summaries built from your entries and refreshed each night, and Mindsera says you can view, edit, delete or switch it off. Auserene's memory works the same way in that respect. Everything it has learned is on the You tab, and you can edit or delete it.

Mindsera doesn't list a meditation or breathing feature on its site, help center or App Store listing. Auserene writes a guided meditation from each day's conversation and has eight guided meditation journeys and 11 ambient sounds.

faq.q: What is a good Mindsera alternative for iPhone?
faq.a: Auserene, if you want a conversation instead of analysis and a meditation made from your day. Rosebud, if you want guided, therapy-informed journals and don't mind paying from day one. Apple Journal, if you want something free and end-to-end encrypted with no AI chat. Our best AI journal apps guide compares more.

informationGain: A disclosed head-to-head built only from Mindsera's own pages on November 19, 2026, including its readable and editable Memory Profile, the try-once limits on its free plan, App Store offers that differ from its site prices, a homepage that still labels emotion analysis 'coming soon', and its consent-based ad and attribution tools, set against Auserene's meditation made from your day.
